# HexPiece 3.6.8

Your newest Mochi notes. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 13 test suites pass, Buzz Cut was rendered in previews, and every
new sound was checked to be a real recording with no pitched tone in it.

## Buzz Cut spirals wider as it spins (both versions)
Your words: "with the more it spins the wider it should get, this applies for every version ... I just want the thing to be wider".
The whirl is now a spiral like your sketch: the arm stretches further out with every turn, from about 3 blocks when it catches to 14
blocks at the end of the whirl (it was 6.5), the giant ball skimming just over the ground the whole way. The white swirls (and
Scorching's ring of fire) widen with it, and anyone the ball sweeps past on the way out is caught too.

## Scorching Buzz Cut: two more spins, a far bigger crater, and it catches properly
Your words: "the awakened version of Buzz Cut should create a much bigger crater and spin 2 more times" and "has a ton of trouble
catching people into the full move, a lot of times it doesnt count the full move".
- It now whirls seven times (Buzz Cut whirls five).
- Its crater is about twice as big: the black star, the cracks, the rubble field and the fire all scaled up, and the ground it breaks
  is wider too (7.5 blocks).
- Whoever the burning wheel rolls over is now carried along pinned under the front of the wheel while you hold N, so when you let go
  they are still right there and the full move always follows. Anyone within 4 blocks when you let go is caught as well.

## New dough sounds
Your words: "literally every sound of dough sounds like shit, get new ones from the web of slime, viscous stuff, dough etc".
Every dough sound of the Mochi fruit is now a real recording of slime, goo or soft clay (all CC0 from Freesound, credited in
sounds/piece/mochi/SOURCES.txt): the arms stretching (slime pulled), the fists landing (three wet slime and clay slaps), mochi forming
and sticking (slime squished), splats, the arm swelling (a long squeeze of slime), the heavy slam and the stomp (the heaviest slime
slaps). The fire, the explosions and the wheel's rumble are not dough and stay as they were.

The Phoenix is next: the owner's model is being brought to life first (the moves come after you have seen it).
